definition.simple: The instruction manual inside every cell. It contains all the genetic information that decides what you look like and how your body works.
definition.academic: A polymer composed of two polynucleotide chains that coil around each other to form a double helix carrying genetic instructions for the development, functioning, growth and reproduction of all known organisms.

examples: Your DNA determines your eye color, height, and natural hair color.

common_misconceptions: DNA is only found in humans. (False: DNA is found in every living thing on Earth, from bacteria to plants to whales).
ai_context.tutor_hint: DNA molecules contain the information necessary for constructing and organizing cells. Functional segments of DNA are called genes!
